crm_notes:
Lead: inbound trial sign-up from small form builder targeting SMBs. Primary persona: Head of Product (Maya Patel) + engineering lead. Key ask: hosted API with clear privacy guarantees.

Prospect concerns / Qs (verbatim & paraphrase):
- "Do you store prompts or form submissions? How long?"
- Wants opt-out toggle per form so customers can choose not to persist prompts for analytics or model improvement.
- Needs ability to delete all data for a user (right-to-be-forgotten flow).
- Data residency: majority of customers NA, some EU customers — may require EU region hosting.
- Legal: needs DPA + SOC2/ISO references.
- Technical: wants TTL control per API key, ability to disable model-improvement usage, and a header-based opt-out (e.g., X-Customer-Data-Use: no-store).
- Concerned about PII in free-text form answers; asked about built-in redaction or recommended pre-send transformations.

What we discussed:
- Walked through hosted API onboarding and trial limits. They liked self-serve flow.
- SE demoed quick pattern: send form text -> run summarization + field extraction -> sync to DB. Prospects worried that prompt logs might be retained in logs or analytics.
- Told them hosted offers configurable retention windows (discussed presets: 7/30/90 days) and enterprise DPA for longer commitments; they asked for the ability to set 0-day retention (no persistent storage) for certain API keys.

Quotes / color:
- "If a user types a password in a free-text field we need to be 100% sure it won't be used for training or show up in logs." — Maya P.
- "We want an opt-out toggle on a per-form basis; also need export/delete endpoints for customers."

Internal notes / recommended next actions for AE/SE:
- Provide DPA draft and SOC2 summary (link to security FAQ).
- Confirm technical feasibility: per-API-key TTL, header opt-out, no-store config for test keys. SE to validate with infra team and respond by 2026-03-18.
- Offer 30-day hosted trial with audit logging enabled; show UI controls in Console for retention.
- If standard hosted API can't provide EU-only region immediately, propose Dedicated footprint or region routing as interim.

Risk: Budget small (SMB); likely to convert if hosted answers data-retention and opt-out flows; otherwise may choose competitor (Typeform + custom pipeline).
